observations.statement: Policy-0A exact memoization can be emitted as a residual-judgement DAG whose cache edges require canonical residual equality after unit propagation and reference only states completed earlier in DFS order.
A separately implemented serialized verifier accepted the exact cache certificate and rejected corrupted cache target, Boolean result, residual key and decision context records.
Among 1,200 deterministic random non-affine UNSAT formulas on four and five variables, production Policy-0A and the traced calculus agreed exactly but no formula produced an exact residual cache hit.

The explicit cache-diamond family makes the no-cache policy expand a complete binary selector prefix while exact Policy-0A retains linearly many states and reaches one residual under opposite decision contexts.

The same diamond family has a constant 31-line ordinary Resolution refutation that ignores every selector and private clause, so its cached-versus-tree speedup is not a Formula-Caching-versus-Resolution separation.
On MAJ3-lifted K4, Policy-0A used 4,117 calls, 2,427 unique states and 888 exact cache hits; the unique-state count exceeded the explicit quadratic envelope 1,296.
The MAJ3-K4 JANUS-FC_local certificate contains 50,796 charged records including 37,432 local Resolution events, while exact cache unfolding expands 4,117 calls to 15,671 call occurrences.

MAJ3-K4 has 438 directly reused residual states and 1,326 direct contexts. In the fixed language of clauses emitted by full C022 unfolding, only five states are covered by one reason, 433 require multiple reasons, 422 require a distinct emitted reason for every direct context, and the exact total minimum is 1,287 reasons.

Unfolding the 438 direct cache targets repeats 1,963 distinct states across 11,156 repeated-state occurrences; only 79 repeated states receive one identical reusable C022 reason, 1,082 occurrences use inherited-unit literals, and one state has 128 distinct emitted reasons.

Policy-0A stores an exact residual and Boolean result but returns no generalized conflict reason. Historical reason-plus-weakening, pool-resolution, regWRTI or restart-enabled clause-learning systems are materially stronger resources and must not be imported without an explicit charged rule.

The graph-tautology probe produced unique-state counts 1,3,12,40,140,738,4001 for order sizes three through nine; at n=9 the CNF has encoding-unit count 789 and the policy spends 1,034,744 local Resolution attempts and 140,097 additions. This remains finite growth evidence only.

Theorem 4.24 of the primary Formula-Caching analysis gives a 2^(n-2) node lower bound even for basic caching with weakening and subsumption on GT_n, but graph tautologies have polynomial regular-Resolution and stronger pool/clause-learning proofs. Transfer to JANUS-FC_local therefore requires robustness under its local Resolution pass and exact separation from any H139 reason upgrade, with all bounds normalized to CNF length.
